difficulty_reason: A composition of local complete intersection morphisms of schemes is again a local complete intersection morphism. The retained proof is complete and explicit: for g : Y -> S and f : X -> Y lci, at x |-> y |-> s choose the defining Koszul factorizations g|_V = pi o i and f|_U = pi' o i' with the normalization (discussion around definition-lci) that P' = A^n_V; then U -> P' = A^n_V -> P'' = A^n_P is a Koszul-regular immersion as the composite of i' (Koszul-regular) with the flat base change of i along P'' -> P (Divisors, lemmas regular-immersion-noetherian and composition-regular-immersion), while P'' -> P -> S is smooth (Morphisms, lemma composition-smooth), so X -> S is Koszul at x. Retained author proof at lines 18213-18242.
